name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Use one Markdown vault for session handoff, source-attributed recall, read-only diagnosis, reviewed lesson proposals, verification evidence and backup recovery. Release v0.15.0 adds authorized Jev-first direct questions with native Noul, Choice and Score, including outside a vault. Existing file-bound judgments stay compatible. Jev is advisory; execution and action permissions remain with the host.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
